answer: The ivory register is checked at draw time, pearl lists the eligible set, and echo seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 64 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 64 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 483 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
